_fixture: Route descriptors are fixtures. No route is certified; the 'verified' flag describes what the app would show after a real channel-map check, not a measurement.

speaker.name: Phone speaker
speaker.detail: Headphone cue needs a second output. The phone speaker plays the master mix only; Cue buttons select but do not monitor.
tradeoffs: Not a performance route; fine for preparation
nextActions: Connect USB-C headphones for a stereo master
Use a DJ splitter for mono master + mono cue
Use a 4-output USB interface for stereo master + stereo cue

bluetooth.name: Bluetooth — Studio Cans (fixture)
bluetooth.summary: Master only over Bluetooth. Delay unknown.
bluetooth.detail: Bluetooth adds delay that the app cannot measure here. Preparation and tolerant playback only; not a scratch or cue route.
nextActions: Use a wired route for performance

usbc-stereo.name: USB-C headphones / DAC
usbc-stereo.detail: Two channels only. The master mix goes to both ears; there is no separate headphone cue.
nextActions: Use a DJ splitter for mono master + mono cue

splitter.name: DJ splitter on USB-C
splitter.detail: The stereo pair is split: left carries the master in mono, right carries the cue in mono. Stereo is given up for independent cueing.
tradeoffs: Channel assignment must match the splitter's wiring
nextActions: Use a 4-output USB interface for stereo on both

usb-4ch.name: USB interface — Quadra 4 (fixture)
usb-4ch.summary: Stereo master on 1–2, stereo cue on 3–4.
usb-4ch.detail: Four outputs negotiated. Master and cue are independent stereo pairs on one device clock.

unsupported.name: USB device — unknown channel map
unsupported.summary: Channel mapping could not be verified.
unsupported.detail: The device reports six outputs but the app could not confirm which carry master and cue. Playback is blocked on this route until the mapping is verified.
nextActions: Choose master and cue pairs manually, then run the isolation check

disconnected.name: Output lost
disconnected.summary: The output device disappeared. Decks are paused and muted.
disconnected.detail: The previous route is no longer available. Nothing was rerouted automatically: the cue mix was not sent to the speaker.
